title: Use an anonymous function
summary: MATLAB: Use an anonymous function. Call twice(7).
introduction: An anonymous function is a short function value. @(n) names its input.
learningObjectives: Use an anonymous function with MATLAB

blocks.text: Use MATLAB. Paste one example into the Command Window, or save it as a .m script and run the script. A MATLAB licence may be required.
The @ input form creates a function taking n. Calling it with 4 returns 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use . operators when a function should work item by item on arrays.
